description: This Java source file contains an abstract test class for testing TenantService and TenantManagementService implementations. It includes a series of unit tests for tenant CRUD operations, handling of resource versions, duplicate tenant detection, trusted CA checks, and lookup by certificate authority. The class provides test verification methods and helper functions to simulate adding and validating tenants within a project, specifically in the context of the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: AbstractTenantServiceTest
classes.description: Abstract class defining common tenant management tests for subclasses that implement specific TenantService and TenantManagementService access methods.

methods.name: assertTenantExists
methods.description: Verifies that a tenant with the given tenantId exists via TenantManagementService.

methods.name: assertTenantDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies that a tenant with the given tenantId does not exist via TenantManagementService.

methods.name: assertGet
methods.description: Helper method to perform a get operation and verify expected HTTP status code.

methods.name: addTenant
methods.description: Helper method to add a tenant by tenantId and optional payload, returning a Future with the operation result.

methods.name: buildTenantPayload
methods.description: Creates a sample JSON payload representing a tenant with default adapter configurations.
